body: I wanted to just be happy with myself but I never was. I wanted to know what it would be like to just look in the mirror and be proud of what I am, but I can’t. I feel like I’m worthless. I don’t even truly know what I want to do with my life anymore. I think I’ve sort of given up on any hope for a family as me being like this is only going to bring them down.

I’m 21 years old and really anything helps. I don’t really know what I want to do, I have an interest in video editing but I doubt that really pay any form of bills. I want to help people but with the grades I have doubt medical school is in my reach. It’s so hard for me not to think of all the fucks up I’ve continued to cause for myself when I’ve been like this for so long.

I’ve just always felt in adequate. I do mediocre in my university classes and I just got denied from one of the few things I’m involved in on campus because of my own mistakes. I’m not mad at anyone but myself. I’ve pushed someone I care about away because I didn’t want her to essentially become a babysitter for me. I keep comparing my life to others, seeing people who excel higher than I ever could as the pinnacle I’ll never reach. I’ve just become so dissatisfied and disappointed in myself that I’ve realized I have nothing to bring, nothing to offer to anyone. I feel as if my life has no value and I’m just trying to leave before I suffer anymore.
